svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.22.1 Installation of Cooktops and Ovens
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.22.1 Installation of Cooktops and Ovens
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION

g.text: Natural gas or propane cooktop and oven:
CSA C22.1, "Canadian Electrical Code, Part I," and CSA B149.1, "Natural gas and propane installation
code," address clearances directly above, in front of, behind and beside the appliance. Where side
clearances are zero, they do not address building elements both above the burner level and to the side.
Articles 9.10.22.2. and 9.10.22.3. cover that. Where both apply, the most stringent criteria govern.
